title: Archive outdated performance goal and add new throughput target
description: The current performance goal 'reduce execution time by 20%' was set 3 months ago and has been largely achieved (18% reduction). Proposal is to archive this goal and add a new throughput target: 'increase workspace throughput by 30% within 2 months'. This aligns with observed scaling patterns and memory of capacity planning.

evidence.evidenceSummary: Goal achieved 18/20% reduction. Throughput observations show sustained increase potential. Capacity memory indicates room for growth.

factors: Goal revision does not affect running plans
mitigation: Old goal remains archived for reference
risk.impactDescription: Changing goals may affect future proposal generation priorities but has no immediate execution impact.
